title: Positive Thinking: What the Research Really Shows and How to Practise It
seoTitle: Positive Thinking: Benefits, Limits and How to Practise
seoDescription: Positive thinking means realistic hope, not denial. See what studies show on optimism and health, why daydreaming backfires, and how to practise it well.
excerpt: The evidence on optimism, honestly rated: the heart and longevity studies, why fantasising about success saps effort, the WOOP and CBT methods that work, and when to see a doctor instead.
